[0] Thanks to a new partnership with RapidSOS, emergency services in Brazil can now request live video from iPhone users. Here are the details.

[1] 緊急 SOS 直播影片功能擴展至巴西

[2] Not everyone knows this, but one of the iPhone’s many emergency features is the ability to share live video with emergency services during a call.

[3] 蘋果公司對此功能的介紹如下：

[4] Share live video or existing photos with emergency services (not available in all countries or regions) If requested by emergency services you can use Emergency SOS Live Video to stream live video or upload existing photos and videos to emergency services.

[7] 蘋果公司指出，緊急服務部門可以保留所分享影片的副本，用戶亦可選擇接受或拒絕分享影片或照片的請求。蘋果公司同時表示，「緊急 SOS 直播影片功能適用於 iPhone 14 或之後型號，受裝置限制，且未必適用於所有情況。」

[8] 公共安全人工智能公司 RapidSOS 於今日宣佈，蘋果的緊急 SOS 直播影片功能現已可供巴西各地的緊急通訊中心（ECCs）使用，讓 iPhone 用戶能夠「在緊急情況下應 190 的要求，安全地分享直播影片」。

[9] 190 是巴西的緊急報警號碼，相當於美國的 911。

[10] RapidSOS 指出，這項技術與其在 2024 年 9 月隨 iOS 18 推出時為美國緊急服務首次啟用的技術相同，並列出了此次整合的三項主要功能：

[11] Simple and Secure for Callers: During an emergency call, if the telecommunicator determines video would help, they can send a request to the caller’s device. The caller sees a prompt and can share their camera’s live video with a single tap. The feature is encrypted by default and the caller can stop sharing at any time. ECC-Controlled: Telecommunicators initiate every video request. ECCs decide if and when to activate the feature for their agency, and can control access by role. Integrated into RapidSOS UNITE: The feature is accessible from within RapidSOS UNITE at no additional cost to Brazil ECCs using UNITE core modules.

[15] RapidSOS 創辦人兼行政總裁 Michael Martin 就今日的公佈表示：「RapidSOS 非常自豪能夠成為在美國率先啟用此功能的平台」，並補充指公司「致力將同樣救命的技術帶到全球各地的緊急服務部門」。
